purpose: Responsibilities referenced by workflow steps. A role is who owns a step (Claude Code, Codex or a human), not a runtime agent, a swarm member or an activation budget.

roles.responsibility: Conducts the dialog, applies the SDD gate, sequences steps and consolidates results.
Turns the conversation into business outcome, success metric and acceptance criteria.
Maps processes, bottlenecks and expected value.
Data intake, data contracts, validation and lineage.
Statistical analysis, hypotheses, bias and feature strategy.
Baselines, training, evaluation and model cards.
Prompts, tools, guardrails and runtime agent blueprints.
Ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexes and retrieval evaluation.
MCP tools, integrations and automation boundaries.
Privacy/LGPD, threat modeling, risk classification and approvals policy.
Human approval gates and guardrail enforcement.
Traces, cost/latency metrics and harness audits.
Tests, eval suites and repeated-trial reliability.

execution_rule: Single assistant first. Split work across more sessions only when the task spans domains that justify it; the user decides.
